opportunities.title: APEX Awards

amount.raw: Applicants can apply for up to £200,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the duration of the award, with teaching and admin duties, based in a UK University or UK not-for-profit research organisation. Up to two Co-applicants from a different Academy remit.
opportunities.summary: APEX Awards (Academies Partnership in Supporting Excellence in Cross-disciplinary research) offer established independent researchers the opportunity to pursue genuine interdisciplinary and blue-skies, curiosity-driven research to benefit wider society, in partnership with the Royal Society, Royal Academy of Engineering and Leverhulme Trust. Awards up to 24 months.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call. Previous successful recipients of this award are not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a gallery, archive, library, museum (GLAM) or performing arts organisation. Awards up to £8,000.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: The symposium covers travel, accommodation, and visa costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany, in the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Call for early career researchers in the humanities and social sciences to attend a research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', in partnership with the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation, taking place 21-23 April 2027. Includes seed funding for international collaborations.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: The Academy funds 80 per cent of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC. Three year award.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation. British citizens and EEA nationals eligible regardless of doctorate origin; any nationality with a UK doctorate eligible. Must have completed Viva Voce between 1 April 2024 and 1 April 2027. Not eligible if appointed to a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three-year Postdoctoral Fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences to pursue an independent research project towards a significant piece of publishable research, funded by DSIT.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in the humanities and social sciences ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or IRO continuing for the full duration of the award. Independent researchers without institutional affiliation not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Awards to promote the acquisition and advancement of skills in relevant areas (quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities, languages) by UK-based researchers, supporting innovative research methods through skills development, collaboration or dissemination. Awards of 6-12 months, up to £10,000.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: Up to £300,000 over 2 years at 80% FEC (total project value at 100% FEC may not exceed £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute, holding an established role lasting at least the duration of the award, of postdoctoral or above status, spending at least 20% time on the award. Co-Applicants based overseas required.
opportunities.summary: International Interdisciplinary Research programme supporting projects led by UK-based researchers in the humanities and social sciences working with international partners on genuinely interdisciplinary projects across SHAPE and STEM disciplines on the theme of Mobilities. Awards up to £300,000 over 2 years.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27

amount.raw: Up to £150,000 for 12 months (with Full Economic Costing at 80 per cent)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Global Innovation Fellowships provide opportunities for UK-based early- and mid-career researchers to develop skills, networks and careers in the creative, cultural, public, private and policy sectors, embedded in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin. Up to two one-year fellowships, up to £150,000.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months. Applicants must meet the eligibility requirements of the scheme they intend to apply for.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require, in addition to the amount already requested for research expenses. Covers specific equipment to overcome barriers, assistance for sensory impairment, caring costs for research trips, and support in making applications. Reviewed on a rolling, case-by-case basis.
